# Junior Jeconia (harshbix)
Frontend-leaning Full-Stack Developer & Product Builder based in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

## Core Capabilities
- Modern Web Applications (React, TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS)
- Full-Stack Architecture (Node.js, Express, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Supabase)
- UI/UX & Design Engineering (Design tokens, Framer Motion, WCAG accessibility, Core Web Vitals)
- Enterprise Systems & Digital Transformation (Bixx Tech, Farols Company, Tanzania Posts Corporation)

## Selected Projects
- Bixx Dictionary: Fast, typography-led lexical reference web app.
- RECAN Foundation: Mission-driven nonprofit digital platform.
- Overspeed Security: Corporate web platform for specialized security operations.
- Henry Peter Portfolio: Cinematic personal brand experience.
- Serene Palette Studio: Accessible color harmony and token generator.
- Bixx Workflow Tracker: Keyboard-first task manager.
